items.text: Adam Christopher Vena is a sanitation employee. He says he entered the race citing concerns about state overreach. Vena says California residents are overtaxed with multiple state and local taxes, and high living costs force families to work multiple jobs. He supports lowering taxes and reducing gasoline prices. He also says the California Air Resources Board is overregulated and lacks checks and balances.
